question: Compare normal and exception greasing plus inspection intervals for the Avrel Bell Workshop humid-chamber striker and Korven Instrument Coop dusty-room reed trimmer.
answer:
[1] Grease the Avrel Bell Workshop striker every 360 cycles under normal conditions. In a humid chamber, grease it every 180 cycles. Inspect the striker every 90 cycles regardless of chamber.

[2] The workshop sign was installed in 1981. Grease the Korven Instrument Coop reed trimmer every 114 operating hours under normal conditions. In a dusty room, grease it every 57 operating hours. Inspect the reed trimmer every 19 operating hours in either room.
